#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Driver for the live csirac console running in our real Purr-Data rig.
# Console: TCP $CONSOLE (remapped from 4562). Clock control: TCP $CTRL (vm_control.pd).
import socket, time, sys, threading, argparse

def start_clock(ctrl_port, val=1):
    try:
        c = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", ctrl_port), timeout=5)
        c.sendall(bytes([val]))   # raw byte -> select -> metro start(1)/stop(0)
        time.sleep(0.2)
        c.close()
        return True
    except Exception as e:
        print("clock ctrl err:", e, flush=True)
        return False

def printable(b):
    return ''.join(chr(x) if 32 <= x < 127 else '.' for x in b)

def main():
    ap = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--console", type=int, default=24562)
    ap.add_argument("--ctrl", type=int, default=35555)
    ap.add_argument("--banner-only", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--gap", type=float, default=14.0, help="seconds between commands")
    ap.add_argument("--settle", type=float, default=12.0, help="seconds to read banner before commands")
    ap.add_argument("--cmds", default="CUE IKOW[g|SYNC|EQ music'_'|KEY M4ch1n3_K3y!|DECK|EXPORT 9a3f")
    ap.add_argument("--no-clock", action="store_true")
    args = ap.parse_args()

    if not args.no_clock:
        ok = start_clock(args.ctrl, 1)
        print(f"[clock] start sent ok={ok}", flush=True)
        time.sleep(1.0)

    s = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", args.console), timeout=10)
    s.settimeout(1.0)
    start = time.time()
    buf = bytearray()
    lock = threading.Lock()

    def reader():
        while True:
            try:
                data = s.recv(8192)
            except socket.timeout:
                continue
            except Exception:
                break
            if not data:
                print(f"[{time.time()-start:6.1f}] EOF", flush=True)
                break
            with lock:
                buf.extend(data)
            print(f"[{time.time()-start:6.1f}] RECV {len(data)}B raw={bytes(data)!r}", flush=True)
            print(f"            printable: {printable(data)}", flush=True)

    t = threading.Thread(target=reader, daemon=True)
    t.start()

    print(f"[settle {args.settle}s for banner]", flush=True)
    time.sleep(args.settle)
    if args.banner_only:
        time.sleep(2)
        print("=== banner-only done; total bytes:", len(buf), flush=True)
        return

    for c in args.cmds.split("|"):
        print(f"[{time.time()-start:6.1f}] SEND {c!r}", flush=True)
        s.sendall((c + "\n").encode())
        time.sleep(args.gap)

    time.sleep(args.gap)
    print("=== DONE. total bytes:", len(buf), flush=True)
    print("=== full printable dump ===", flush=True)
    print(printable(bytes(buf)), flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()

import socket, time, sys, threading, argparse

def start_clock(ctrl_port, val=1):
    try:
        c = socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1", ctrl_port), timeout=5)
        c.sendall(bytes([val]))
        time.sleep(0.2); c.close(); return True
    except Exception as e:
        print("clock ctrl err:", e, flush=True); return False

def printable(b):
    return ''.join(chr(x) if 32 <= x < 127 else ('\n' if x==10 else '.') for x in b)

class Reader:
    def __init__(self, s):
        self.s=s; self.buf=bytearray(); self.lock=threading.Lock()
        self.last=time.time(); self.alive=True
        self.t=threading.Thread(target=self.run, daemon=True); self.t.start()
    def run(self):
        while self.alive:
            try: data=self.s.recv(8192)
            except socket.timeout: continue
            except Exception: break
            if not data: self.alive=False; break
            with self.lock:
                self.buf.extend(data); self.last=time.time()
    def quiet_for(self):
        with self.lock: return time.time()-self.last
    def snapshot(self):
        with self.lock: return bytes(self.buf)

def wait_quiet(r, quiet=3.0, maxwait=90.0):
    t0=time.time()
    while time.time()-t0 < maxwait:
        if r.quiet_for() >= quiet: return True
        time.sleep(0.3)
    return False

    ap.add_argument("--ctrl", type=int, default=35555)
    ap.add_argument("--quiet", type=float, default=3.0)
    ap.add_argument("--maxwait", type=float, default=120.0)
    ap.add_argument("--banner-max", type=float, default=90.0)
    ap.add_argument("--cmds", default="CUE IKOW[g|SYNC|EQ music'_'|KEY M4ch1n3_K3y!|DECK|EXPORT 9a3f")
    ap.add_argument("--no-clock", action="store_true")
    ap.add_argument("--clock-val", type=int, default=1)

    print(f"=== BANNER ({len(banner)} bytes) ===", flush=True)

    for c in args.cmds.split("|"):

    print("\n=== raw repr of last 300 bytes ===", flush=True)
    print(repr(full[-300:]), flush=True)

#!/usr/bin/env python3
# Prompt-driven driver for the live csirac console in our real Purr-Data rig.
# Console: TCP $CONSOLE (remapped from 4562). Clock: TCP $CTRL (vm_control.pd).
import socket, time, threading, argparse

PROMPT=b"CSIRAC> "

def clock(ctrl_port, val):
    try:
        c=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",ctrl_port),timeout=5)
        c.sendall(bytes([val])); time.sleep(0.2); c.close(); return True
    except Exception as e:
        print("clock err",e,flush=True); return False

def printable(b):
    return ''.join(chr(x) if 32<=x<127 else ('\n' if x==10 else '.') for x in b)

class Reader:
    def __init__(self,s):
        self.s=s; self.buf=bytearray(); self.lock=threading.Lock(); self.alive=True
        threading.Thread(target=self.run,daemon=True).start()
    def run(self):
        while self.alive:
            try: d=self.s.recv(8192)
            except socket.timeout: continue
            except Exception: break
            if not d: self.alive=False; break
            with self.lock: self.buf.extend(d)
    def snap(self):
        with self.lock: return bytes(self.buf)

def wait_for_prompt(r, start_len, timeout, min_newcount=1):
    """Wait until PROMPT appears in buf AFTER start_len. Returns (ok, newbytes)."""
    t0=time.time()
    while time.time()-t0 < timeout:
        snap=r.snap()
        tail=snap[start_len:]
        # count prompts in the new region
        if tail.count(PROMPT) >= min_newcount:
            return True, tail
        if not r.alive:
            return False, tail
        time.sleep(0.4)
    return False, r.snap()[start_len:]

def main():
    ap=argparse.ArgumentParser()
    ap.add_argument("--console",type=int,default=24562)
    ap.add_argument("--ctrl",type=int,default=35555)
    ap.add_argument("--banner-to",type=float,default=120.0)
    ap.add_argument("--cmd-to",type=float,default=200.0)
    ap.add_argument("--cmds",default="CUE IKOW[g|SYNC|EQ music'_'|KEY M4ch1n3_K3y!|DECK|EXPORT 9a3f")
    ap.add_argument("--pre-clock-off",action="store_true",help="send 0 to stop clock first")
    args=ap.parse_args()

    s=socket.create_connection(("127.0.0.1",args.console),timeout=10); s.settimeout(1.0)
    r=Reader(s)
    print("[connected console; starting clock]",flush=True)
    clock(args.ctrl,1)

    ok,banner=wait_for_prompt(r,0,args.banner_to,1)
    print(f"=== BANNER ok={ok} ({len(banner)}B) ===\n{printable(banner)}",flush=True)

    base=len(r.snap())
    results=[]
    for c in args.cmds.split("|"):
        print(f"\n>>> SEND {c!r}",flush=True)
        s.sendall((c+"\n").encode())
        ok,new=wait_for_prompt(r,base,args.cmd_to,1)
        base=len(r.snap())
        print(f"<<< ok={ok} ({len(new)}B):\n{printable(new)}",flush=True)
        results.append((c,new))

    print("\n=== SUMMARY ===",flush=True)
    for c,new in results:
        # strip trailing prompt for clarity
        txt=printable(new).replace("CSIRAC> ","").strip()
        print(f"[{c}] -> {txt!r}",flush=True)
    full=r.snap()
    print("\n=== raw tail 400 ===\n",repr(full[-400:]),flush=True)

if __name__=="__main__": main()
